metadata.Title: How AI will answer questions we haven't thought to ask
metadata.中文标题: AI 如何回答我们尚未想到的问题
metadata.Speaker: Aravind Srinivas

second_pass.method: 回看未选句段并复核已有引文内的普通实词；补充比例、目的、状态与评注词块和assistant/full等语境词义

chunks.meaning: 大学辍学；drop out of后接退出的机构或活动
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: I never dropped out of college.

chunks.meaning: 继续走下去／继续做某事
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: In fact, I kept going.

chunks.meaning: 为某个事实感到自豪
chunks.note: 原文语境候选，不因出现一次声称高频。
chunks.quote: And it’s OK to be proud that I have a PhD in AI from Berkeley, right here in the Bay Area.

chunks.meaning: 只有时间能说明答案；对未来判断留余地
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: Only time will tell if this is a new trend of seeing academics in technology startups.

chunks.meaning: 产生好奇心；原句to find out if ...交代好奇后想弄清什么
chunks.note: get + 形容词表示状态变化；此处保留表达动作，不把to find out if后面的内容当固定词块。
chunks.quote: But I got pretty curious to find out if this is common or new.

chunks.meaning: 后来发现／结果是……
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: And it turns out this is somewhat new.

chunks.meaning: 与某事相关联；相关不等于因果
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: Yet our attendance here today and the trend in AI technology broadly does not seem to correlate with this finding.

chunks.meaning: B个中有A个；比例或人数表达
chunks.note: 原文语境候选，不因出现一次声称高频。
chunks.quote: I mean, quite a lot. 11 out of 24 speakers just at this conference have PhDs, and over a third are assistant, associate or full professors with major universities.

chunks.meaning: 与此同时／在等待期间
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: In the meantime, my curiosity led me to another question: What was the last major technology company founded by academics?

chunks.meaning: 被指责做某事
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: At Perplexity, we get accused of trying to kill Google a lot.

chunks.meaning: 相信我／听我的……；强调说话人确信
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: But trust me, we're not really trying to kill things.

chunks.meaning: 听某人说／了解某人的观点；本句引入视频发言
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: Let's hear from Larry Page.

chunks.meaning: 在那时／当年
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: I was only six back then.

chunks.meaning: 对某事有想法／看法
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: I'm sure a lot of you have lots of thoughts about these questions.

chunks.meaning: 在某种意义上／从某个角度来说
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: In some sense, that is the purpose of technology: to keep us thinking and to keep us evolving.

chunks.meaning: 脱离背景、孤立地；本句非真空实验环境
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: But people like Larry, or people like you or people like me, we are not building technology in a vacuum.

chunks.meaning: 使某人持续做某事
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: In some sense, that is the purpose of technology: to keep us thinking and to keep us evolving.

chunks.meaning: 我们知道的有多么少；强调知识有限
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: Socrates, the Greek philosopher, is famous for saying that wisdom comes from realizing how little we know, or that progress can only be made by asking better questions.

chunks.meaning: 通过做某事取得进步；原句被动
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: Socrates, the Greek philosopher, is famous for saying that wisdom comes from realizing how little we know, or that progress can only be made by asking better questions.

chunks.meaning: 是某事的核心／对其至关重要
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: It has been core to the progress of human intellect over the past 1,000 years.

chunks.meaning: 好出好几个数量级；在本演讲中是强调能力差距的说法
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: Relentless questioning is also a practice that can be done orders of magnitude better with the power of AI.

chunks.meaning: 玩笑归玩笑，认真地说……
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: So, jokes aside, relentless questioning is something fundamentally human.

chunks.meaning: 引出、导致某结果；本句是引出新的一组问题
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: It seems like for humans, every answer leads to a new set of questions.

chunks.chunk: That is what … should be about.
chunks.meaning: 这才应当是……的核心／真正要做的事
chunks.note: 原文语境候选，不因出现一次声称高频。
chunks.quote: That, to me, is what the future of technology should be about.

chunks.meaning: 走进真实社会／离开受保护的学习环境
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: So when I actually entered the real world and tried to do my own company, I had an endless set of questions.

chunks.meaning: 弄清／搞明白某事
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: I needed to figure all these things out.

chunks.meaning: 让某人无所适从、不知怎么判断
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: And traditional search engines left me lost.

chunks.meaning: 能够接触、获得或使用某种资源
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: And neither did I have access to all of the experts on all these topics.

chunks.meaning: 大量的某物；随意口语
chunks.note: 原文语境候选，不因出现一次声称高频。
chunks.quote: There was a ton of information and very little time to evaluate any of it.

chunks.chunk: be in a state of sth.
chunks.meaning: 处于某种状态
chunks.note: 原文语境候选，不因出现一次声称高频。
chunks.quote: So I was actually truly in a state of perplexity.

chunks.meaning: 让某人／某物做某事；本句安排AI代做研究
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: So that's when I thought, maybe I could have an AI do this for me.

chunks.meaning: 从某处获取信息
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: Maybe I could go ask an AI all these questions, if it was able to pull information from the web and answer all my questions.

chunks.chunk: no matter one's level of expertise
chunks.meaning: 不论专业水平高低
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: For the first time, I had the ability to go ask whatever question I wanted about any topic, no matter my level of expertise in it, and get a well-researched answer from the web.

chunks.meaning: 附有来源／出处
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: In this case, every answer in Perplexity comes with sources from the web in the form of citations, just like academics cite their sources.

chunks.meaning: 以某种形式呈现
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: In this case, every answer in Perplexity comes with sources from the web in the form of citations, just like academics cite their sources.

chunks.meaning: 引用／注明自己的信息来源
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: In this case, every answer in Perplexity comes with sources from the web in the form of citations, just like academics cite their sources.

chunks.meaning: 后续追问／跟进问题
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: In the case of humans, an answer you could trust allows you to ask better follow-up questions.

chunks.meaning: 从一开始就一直如此
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: And in Perplexity, ever since the beginning, every answer has always come with sources that allows you to ask more questions.

chunks.meaning: 从做某事中获益
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: What areas outside of insurance could I benefit from having access to better answers?

chunks.meaning: 某特征只存在于某类事物／为其所独有；原句否定
chunks.note: 原文语境候选，不因出现一次声称高频。
chunks.quote: Now this is pretty powerful because trust is not unique to animals or humans, but it empowers us pretty differently.

chunks.meaning: 直到不久前；用于旧情况最近才改变
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: Until recently, if you wanted the best answers, you had to be someone who could afford it.

chunks.meaning: 最优秀的头脑／杰出的思想家、专家
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: You had to be someone who had access to the greatest minds in the world or the best materials, libraries, expertise.

chunks.meaning: 即使……也不影响这里的判断／不论是否……
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: It doesn't matter if you're a Harvard professor or an underserved student in a developing nation, we all get access to the same answers.

chunks.chunk: get better and better at doing sth.
chunks.meaning: 越来越擅长做某事
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: With AI that keeps getting better and better at answering all our questions, the marginal cost of research is rapidly approaching zero.

chunks.meaning: 趋近于零；原句rapidly补充迅速这一速度信息
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: With AI that keeps getting better and better at answering all our questions, the marginal cost of research is rapidly approaching zero.

chunks.meaning: 重要的是……；突出判断重点
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: Rather, what matters is the next question you're going to ask.

chunks.meaning: 不禁要问／只能好奇……；引出开放问题
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: When all of the world's answers are available to all of the world's people, one can only wonder: What will the best questions be, and how many such questions will get asked?

chunks.meaning: 潜力没有上限／大有可为；鼓励性比喻
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: As long as we keep engaging in relentless questioning and keep asking an interesting set of questions, the sky is the limit in terms of what we can actually learn.

chunks.meaning: 在某方面／就某标准而言
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: As long as we keep engaging in relentless questioning and keep asking an interesting set of questions, the sky is the limit in terms of what we can actually learn.

chunks.meaning: 从A到B，覆盖一段范围
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: Once I got answers to something like health insurance, I could ask an infinite set of new questions, ranging from very pointed ones, like, what are concrete ways to improve the health care insurance industry, to very broad ones, like, who else would benefit from having access to such a technology?

chunks.meaning: 持续掌握／追踪某事的进展
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: It seems to a curious species every question and answer that you get is a lead to the next set of questions, and spawns several paths of curiosity, more than any one person can keep track of.

chunks.chunk: It is my strong belief that …
chunks.meaning: 我坚信……；明确陈述个人判断
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: It is my strong belief that in an age where AI gets better and better at answering all our questions, this human quality that makes us so human will become even more essential.

chunks.meaning: 在一个……的时代
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: It is my strong belief that in an age where AI gets better and better at answering all our questions, this human quality that makes us so human will become even more essential.

chunks.meaning: 至少我个人……；强调自己明确的态度
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: And I, for one, can't wait to see what you will ask next.

chunks.meaning: 迫不及待想看到……
chunks.note: 按本句语境理解；原文观点不作为频率或效果证明。
chunks.quote: And I, for one, can't wait to see what you will ask next.

chunks.meaning: 更重要的是；把话题重心进一步提高
chunks.note: 原文语境候选，不因出现一次声称高频。
chunks.quote: And more importantly, that is the future of us, the future of humans.
